title: The Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored…
description: The Forminator Forms WordPress plugin up to version 1.58.4 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'upload-1' File Upload field parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users access the affected pages. Exploitation requires the File Upload field to be at default settings without custom file restrictions and a server configuration that does not map a Content-Type to the .rtx extension, which is common in Debian/Ubuntu Apache setups and some shared hosts. This issue is an incomplete fix of CVE-2024-1794.
